semiconductor_relevance: High — CHEMI FLON provides critical fluoro resin components used in fluid handling and supply systems, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CHEMI FLON specializes in the development and production of high-quality fluoro resin components, including tubes and fittings, for semiconductor applications. The company leverages advanced raw material usage and high-precision welding technology to deliver custom-designed components tailored to specific customer needs, particularly in the display and energy sectors.
